figures.Fig16.7: Observation of reactions of halide ions with AgNO3. Original figure archived as c11-chem-ch16-fig-ion-tests (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The print reads 'NH gas' and 'waler'; the halide equations print with garbled charges; the nitrate equation is reconstructed as 3NO3- + 8Al + 5OH- + 18H2O -> 3NH3 + 8[Al(OH)4]-. Quick Check 16.3 is used as the self-check; the ring test and insoluble sulfates are answered from standard chemistry since the text does not describe them.
